Order 
Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner made a submission that on instructions, she has chosen to withdraw the writ petition.

So she seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition and she has also made an endorsement to that effect.
2.
In view of the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the endorsement made by her, the writ petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
No costs.
